verdicts.reason: A: the logo is shrunk to a tiny smudge in a wide, empty white panel. The two-line headline runs right up against the undersized 'Reserve a Case' button, and the body copy and 'Ships late June' are too small to read at banner size. B: the logo is a sensible size, and the logo/headline/body/CTA columns read cleanly left to right. However, the four-line headline fills almost the full height with no top or bottom margin, the body column and CTA are tiny, and the eyebrow has been moved away from the headline to sit under the logo.
